gol0: Has the benefit of exercise been proven?
gol1: Golfer’s elbow has been studied less than tennis elbow. In a 2026 systematic review of five studies covering 143 people, eccentric exercises, which work the muscle while it lengthens, reduced pain and improved function; the best results were seen when they were combined with other treatments. However, the studies were few and small, and the certainty of the evidence is low.
